title: Endina Ramayana
desc: A family falls apart after Bharath, who does not attend his brother Shankar's wedding, claims his sister-in-law is a prostitute. However, when Shankar investigates, he discovers a shocking truth.

title: Devil's Double Next Level
desc: A brutally honest film critic is invited to an exclusive preview of a horror-laced movie by an enigmatic filmmaker. However, events take a surreal turn when he finds himself trapped inside the film.

title: Kaatera
desc: Kaatera, a blacksmith from a village named Bheemanahalli, goes through numerous threats so that a reforms act gets implemented which gives freedom to the farmers from feudal landlords.

title: Elumale
desc: A chance encounter near the Tamil Nadu-Karnataka border in 2004 plunges a cab driver and a young woman into a tense night filled with lurking threats.

title: Akhanda 2
desc: Renowned warrior Akhanda resurfaces to confront a dangerous tantric practitioner sowing chaos. However, he is not alone in his quest for peace as his twin brother Murali Krishna joins the fight.
